notes: ABB ACS580 series drive with Elektronikon controller. 16-bit register access: Modbus register = 40000 + parameter number (e.g., param 01.06 → reg 40106). Wire address = register - 40001. Motor speed and frequency return 0-20000 scaled values — multiply by nameplate/20000. Motor current resolution depends on par 46.05 (default=10000 → whole amps; set 46.05=100 for 0.01A on drives ≤65A). Also supports 32-bit access: register = 420000 + (200×group) + (2×index), requires par 58.33=0 (default). Source: ABB Technical Note 062 (LVD-EOTKN062U-EN REV A, 2021-06-22).
address_note: Wire address = Modbus register - 40001. E.g., register 40106 → wire address 105. Configure Modbus slave address via par 54.01.
configuration_notes: For best resolution: set par 46.01 = motor nameplate RPM, par 46.02 = motor nameplate Hz, par 46.05 = 100 (for drives ≤65A) or 1000 (for drives >65A). This ensures speed/frequency/current return values with proper scaling.

registers.description: Par 01.01 — Motor Speed Used. Returns 0-20000. Scale = nameplate_rpm / 20000. Default nameplate = 1800 rpm → scale 0.09. Adjust scale for actual motor.
Par 01.06 — Output Frequency. Returns 0-20000. Scale = nameplate_Hz / 20000. Default 60 Hz → scale 0.003. Adjust for 50 Hz motors (scale = 0.0025).
Par 01.07 — Motor Current. Default resolution: 1A whole number (par 46.05=10000). If par 46.05=100: scale=0.01. If par 46.05=1000: scale=0.1.
Par 01.10 — Motor Torque (% of nominal). Resolution 0.01%.
Par 01.20 — Inverter kWh Counter (0.1 kWh). Accumulated energy consumption.
Par 05.11 — Inverter Temperature (% of overtemp threshold). 100% = overtemp fault. NOT in °C — ABB only exposes percentage.
Par 06.16 — Drive Status Word 1. Bit8=local, Bit10=Ext1, Bit11=Ext2. Contains run/stop/fault/warning bits.
Par 04.40 — Event Word 1 (faults + warnings). Bits configurable via par 04.41-04.71. Configure in drive to expose relevant faults for your application.
Par 04.11 — Last Fault Code. Convert to hex and compare with ABB fault list. 0 = no fault.
